# Nivra 0.1.0-alpha.12

## Unreal Engine 5 alongside Unity

- Adds a shared `GameEngineProvider` architecture with separate Unity and Unreal providers.
- Detects `.uproject` files, Blueprint/C++/hybrid projects, modules, plugins, project engine association and generated folders.
- Detects Epic Games Launcher installations, common Windows engine paths, custom paths and source-built Unreal Engine 5 installations.
- Creates minimal valid Blueprint, C++ and hybrid Unreal projects with optional Git and Git LFS.
- Adds a project-local `NivraBridge` plugin with authenticated, localhost-only communication and a versioned protocol.

## AI-first Unreal workflow

- Adds structured Unreal tools for editor status, maps, actors, components, assets, Blueprints, materials, gameplay classes, UI, C++, tests, PIE, screenshots, builds and packaging.
- Claude receives native Unreal status/action/build/package tools.
- Codex receives Unreal project context, Unreal skills and a local `nivra-unreal.ps1` helper.
- Every operation reports real files, assets, commands, output, warnings, errors and verification state in Agent Activity.
- Global Stop cancels queued bridge work and Nivra-started Unreal build/package processes where cancellation is supported.

## Game Development workspace

- Adds Unity/Unreal engine selection, Unreal project creation, installation selection and a real Unreal cockpit.
- Shows editor, bridge, map, PIE and compilation state, selected actors/assets, output logs and diagnostics.
- Real controls for Launch, Reconnect, Save All, Compile, Build, Package, Play, Stop, screenshot, actors, assets and logs.
- Preserves Unity support and independent project state in multiple Nivra windows.

## Safety and reliability

- Never edits `.uasset` or `.umap` as text.
- Validates project paths, descriptors, bridge tokens and action arguments.
- Unreal child processes run without flashing Command Prompt or PowerShell windows and stream output into Nivra.
- Does not claim arbitrary Blueprint graph generation or completed Unreal templates unless the editor verifies them.

## Validation

- 73 automated tests passed; one opt-in live Unreal Editor integration test was skipped because the build host has no Unreal Editor.
- Go race test, `go vet`, JavaScript syntax, generated bridge Python syntax, Windows x64 GUI build and reproducible source rebuild passed.
